title: Same-hour sensitivity
question: When an event's probability jumps, do the assets linked to that event move more than unrelated assets?
headline: In shock hours, related assets move +0.25× (of normal-hour size) more than unrelated assets (95% CI +0.15 to +0.34, 366 markets). Without crypto-price markets: +0.22× (CI +0.11 to +0.34).
notes: Direction-free test (a market's YES can be good or bad news for an asset).
Pass rule: mapped-minus-placebo ratio > 0 with the 95% CI above 0 (bootstrap over markets); fewer than 30 markets = inconclusive.
